posts.text: Congratulations to the Artemis II crew on setting a new record for the farthest journey from Earth! What an incredible view!

The SAVE Act is about making sure only the “right people” are allowed to vote.

If those who wanted to limit voting to the “right people” in the 1960s had succeeded, I wouldn’t be a Senator.
There’s money for war but there’s no money to feed hungry families?

Happy Easter!  

May the spirit and promise of resurrection inspire us in the fight for a more just and loving world. After all, the story of Easter affirms that LOVE will have the final say.  Let us rejoice & be grateful for one another. Have a blessed and wonderful Easter!

Video

The SAVE Act is designed to create a massive obstacle course on the way to the polling booth.  
 
The ENTIRE goal is to make it harder for you to vote.

I may be from Savannah, but Atlanta holds a special place in my heart. The cradle of the Civil Rights Movement, the hip-hop capital of the world, and a hub of economic enterprise—Atlanta keeps raising the bar.
Happy #404Day, Atlanta!

58 years ago today, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., Georgia’s greatest son, was taken from us in a violent act of hate.

His legacy lives on in the work we do to build his beloved community and to bend the moral arc of the universe towards justice.

This is the sad reality.  
 
Under Donald Trump, health insurance now costs more than the mortgage for many Americans.

They are proposing cuts to clean water, education, housing and more. 

To spend even MORE money on war. 

Let that sink in. 

The administration in Washington does not care about you.

The President cut your health care so that he could build a paramilitary force that is accountable only to him.  
 
It’s alarming and it’s wrong.
Good Friday reminds us that even in our darkest moments, hope is not lost. The story does not end on Friday. Easter is coming.

One year since so-called "Liberation Day" and the results are in.

Everything has gotten more expensive while American manufacturing jobs disappear.

I would submit that it's a strange liberation and a curious freedom that raises prices and leaves you unemployed.

One month ago, the President said the war in Iran would last 4-5 weeks.

It’s been a month and now we’re being told just a couple more weeks.

The President got us into yet another war in the Middle East with no exit plan.

Long overdue. 

While he's at it, Trump should fire Pete Hegseth and RFK Jr. immediately.

We suffer not from a poverty of resources, but from a lack of moral imagination.


Headquarters (@HQNewsNow)

Trump: We can't take care of daycare. We're a big country, we have 50 states, all these people, we're fighting wars. It's not possible for us to take care of daycare, Medicaid, Medicare, all these things

Video

So very proud to sit with my 7 and 9-year-old children tonight and watch the Artemis II team’s historic launch into space! 🚀 Inspiring!  American innovation and genius in motion!
Wishing the Jewish community in Georgia and around the world a joyful Passover! May this season bring bountiful blessings, good health & peace to you all. Chag Sameach!

Why does the President want to disenfranchise millions of Americans?  

Why is he so afraid that people will make their voices heard?  

It's because he is losing.

The President’s attack on mail-in ballots is desperation plain and simple.

It’s a panicked attempt to silence the people and salvage a failing presidency.

It will not stand.

I will not vote to give another dime to ICE until they stop trampling our rights.
